-------------------------CCD_DCUSTOMER CCD_MCUSTOMER----------------------------------

WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_ANN_SALARY)),0) CUST_ANN_SALARY_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_GANN_SALARY)),0) CUST_GANN_SALARY_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_CRLIMIT)),0) CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT)),0) CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_CASH_LIMIT)),0) CUST_CASH_LIMIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_AVAIL_CASH)),0) CUST_AVAIL_CASH_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT)),0) CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT)),0) CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_INSTL_LIMIT)),0) CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_AVAIL_INSTL)),0) CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_STDALN_INSTL)),0) CUST_STDALN_INSTL_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS)),0) CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_tgt
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_CBCEXCUSTP WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
UNION ALL
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_ANN_SALARY)),0) CUST_ANN_SALARY_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_GANN_SALARY)),0) CUST_GANN_SALARY_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_CRLIMIT)),0) CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT)),0) CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_CASH_LIMIT)),0) CUST_CASH_LIMIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_AVAIL_CASH)),0) CUST_AVAIL_CASH_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT)),0) CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT)),0) CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_INSTL_LIMIT)),0) CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_AVAIL_INSTL)),0) CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_STDALN_INSTL)),0) CUST_STDALN_INSTL_tgt
,  isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS)),0) CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_tgt
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_CBCEXCUSFP WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,CUST_ANN_SALARY CUST_ANN_SALARY_src
,CUST_GANN_SALARY CUST_GANN_SALARY_src
,CUST_CRLIMIT CUST_CRLIMIT_src
,CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_src
,CUST_CASH_LIMIT CUST_CASH_LIMIT_src
,CUST_AVAIL_CASH CUST_AVAIL_CASH_src
,CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src
,CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_src
,CUST_INSTL_LIMIT CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_src
,CUST_AVAIL_INSTL CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_src
,CUST_STDALN_INSTL CUST_STDALN_INSTL_src
,CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_src
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_CBCEXCUSTP WHERE H <> 'D'
UNION ALL
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,CUST_ANN_SALARY CUST_ANN_SALARY_src
,CUST_GANN_SALARY CUST_GANN_SALARY_src
,CUST_CRLIMIT CUST_CRLIMIT_src
,CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_src
,CUST_CASH_LIMIT CUST_CASH_LIMIT_src
,CUST_AVAIL_CASH CUST_AVAIL_CASH_src
,CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src
,CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_src
,CUST_INSTL_LIMIT CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_src
,CUST_AVAIL_INSTL CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_src
,CUST_STDALN_INSTL CUST_STDALN_INSTL_src
,CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_src
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_CBCEXCUSFP WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, CUST_ANN_SALARY_tgt
, CUST_GANN_SALARY_tgt
, CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
, CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_tgt
, CUST_CASH_LIMIT_tgt
, CUST_AVAIL_CASH_tgt
, CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt
, CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt
, CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_tgt
, CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_tgt
, CUST_STDALN_INSTL_tgt
, CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_tgt
, CUST_ANN_SALARY_src
, CUST_GANN_SALARY_src
, CUST_CRLIMIT_src
, CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_src
, CUST_CASH_LIMIT_src
, CUST_AVAIL_CASH_src
, CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src
, CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_src
, CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_src
, CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_src
, CUST_STDALN_INSTL_src
, CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(CUST_ANN_SALARY_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_ANN_SALARY_tgt
,CAST(CUST_GANN_SALARY_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_GANN_SALARY_tgt
,CAST(CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
,CAST(CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_tgt
,CAST(CUST_CASH_LIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_CASH_LIMIT_tgt
,CAST(CUST_AVAIL_CASH_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_AVAIL_CASH_tgt
,CAST(CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt
,CAST(CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt
,CAST(CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_tgt
,CAST(CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_tgt
,CAST(CUST_STDALN_INSTL_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_STDALN_INSTL_tgt
,CAST(CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_tgt
,CAST(CUST_ANN_SALARY_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_ANN_SALARY_src
,CAST(CUST_GANN_SALARY_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_GANN_SALARY_src
,CAST(CUST_CRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_CRLIMIT_src
,CAST(CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_src
,CAST(CUST_CASH_LIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_CASH_LIMIT_src
,CAST(CUST_AVAIL_CASH_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_AVAIL_CASH_src
,CAST(CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src
,CAST(CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_src
,CAST(CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_src
,CAST(CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_src
,CAST(CUST_STDALN_INSTL_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_STDALN_INSTL_src
,CAST(CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, CUST_ANN_SALARY_src
, CUST_GANN_SALARY_src
, CUST_CRLIMIT_src
, CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_src
, CUST_CASH_LIMIT_src
, CUST_AVAIL_CASH_src
, CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src
, CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_src
, CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_src
, CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_src
, CUST_STDALN_INSTL_src
, CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_src )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, CUST_ANN_SALARY_tgt
, CUST_GANN_SALARY_tgt
, CUST_CRLIMIT_tgt
, CUST_AVAIL_CREDIT_tgt
, CUST_CASH_LIMIT_tgt
, CUST_AVAIL_CASH_tgt
, CUST_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt
, CUST_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt
, CUST_INSTL_LIMIT_tgt
, CUST_AVAIL_INSTL_tgt
, CUST_STDALN_INSTL_tgt
, CUST_AVAIL_STDALN_INS_tgt )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
